free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No egress SKU for Object Storage or general internet traffic exists in the price API (only CDN and Container Registry traffic SKUs), and the product page does not mention egress. A former STACKIT network price page that reportedly said data traffic was free now redirects to a general page, so the statement could not be read today.

egress_fair_use.note: No egress terms were found in the sources checked.

free_tier.note: No free tier for Object Storage is stated on the product page or in the price API.

object_lock.note: S3 Object Lock (COMPLIANCE and GOVERNANCE, Legal Hold); requires the project-level Compliance Lock, enabled at bucket creation only; maximum retention 365 days (limits page).

s3_endpoints.note: Concepts page: 'Object Storage supports both Virtual Hosted Style and Path Style'. The AWS CLI guide uses region name eu01 (https://docs.stackit.cloud/products/storage/object-storage/how-tos/set-up-cli-client/).
Both virtual-hosted and path style are supported (concepts page). Signing region eu02 assumed by analogy with the documented eu01 example.

notes: Prices come from STACKIT's public price API (https://pim.api.stackit.cloud/v1/skus), which also feeds the product page price table; monthly prices there are 720-hour extrapolations of the hourly GB price.
The price API also lists 'Object Storage for Archiving Premium-EU01' (SKU ST-0110301) at the same price; it belongs to the separate STACKIT Archiving Service and is not modelled.
Limits (limits page): tenant quota 500 TB (adjustable), 2500 read/write requests per second and 500 MB/s per project.
